{{Top}}
A '''blue dwarf''' was a classification of [[Star/Legends|star]]. The star of the [[Verde system/Legends|Verde system]] was a blue dwarf.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> Another was [[Asar/Legends|Asar]], the star of the [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]]. Asar was considered "exceedingly bright" for its star type.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
